name: Voxel Path Tracing with Chunked Storage
definition: A voxel path tracing engine that calculates lighting per-voxel instead of per-pixel, allowing for dynamic streaming and fast map edits by separating voxels into 8x8x8 chunks.
summary: Voxel Path Tracing with Chunked Storage is a per-voxel lighting method that decouples illumination from rendering to enable dynamic streaming and instant edits by organizing voxels into 8x8x8 chunks.
